problem_statement: Backport rejection of ASCII whitespace in xmlattr attribute keys while preserving escaping, omitted values, the historical function signature and autospace behavior.
notes: The reference patch adapts the upstream implementation to the historical function location; its Jinja-derived code is BSD-3-Clause under LICENSE.upstream.
The external behavioral oracle is original evaluation code under the compilation MIT license; it tests all six ASCII whitespace characters and three compatibility controls.
Only tests/test_filters.py and the external oracle are selected; later attribute-key vulnerabilities and the full project suite are outside this case.
